description: This file defines Redux action creators for navigation-related UI interactions in a React/Redux e-commerce application, including toggling menus and fetching search suggestions.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Action creator to toggle the menu visibility.

methods.name: toggleCart
methods.description: Action creator to toggle the cart visibility.

methods.name: toggleBrand
methods.description: Action creator to toggle the brand filter.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Action creator to handle search input changes.

methods.name: onSuggestionsFetchRequested
methods.description: Async action creator to fetch search suggestions based on input value.

methods.name: onSuggestionsClearRequested
methods.description: Action creator to clear search suggestions.
